crop.notes: Whole boxed advertisement 'Great Fight for $10,000 and the World's Title'.

ocr.notes: Matches the image apart from 'Letween' for 'Between'; the headline is not in the text.

title.suggested: Great Fight for $10,000 and the World's Title

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Star advertised that next Sunday's paper would carry Prof. Bill Clark's story, told to Billy Murphy, of the Tom Allen and Jem Mace fight for $10,000 and the world's title in New Orleans.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'Monday, The St. Louis Star, January 22, 1912', page 4; the box is at the bottom of the right column.

notes: A promotional box for the Star's 'Great Stories of the Ring' No. 4 by Prof. Bill Clark. It names Allen as the winner; Jem Mace won the 1870 fight, so no fight facts are taken from it. The current summary presents the ad as if it were the fight report.
